tests.fail_or_repair: Open a person-status docket and downgrade receipt or portal evidence to denominator state.
tests.label: Person, family, identity, and representative lane
tests.question: Does the packet bind the person/family unit, A-number, receipt numbers, aliases, representative/helper, language/disability needs, address, and urgent service consequences before accepting status evidence?

tests.fail_or_repair: Do not treat case-status or processing-time rows as status or work proof until case action and notice evidence are joined.
tests.label: Receipt, case status, and processing-time boundary
tests.question: Are receipt, case status, office/form/category, processing-time posture, service request, biometrics, RFE/NOID, and decision/card production separated?

tests.fail_or_repair: Treat address form submission as incomplete until both relevant agencies and actual notice consequences are verified.
tests.label: Notice and address split across USCIS and EOIR
tests.question: Are USCIS address records, EOIR address records, service proof, portal/email/SMS notice, returned mail, and deadline/hearing consequences joined?

tests.fail_or_repair: Treat I-589 upload or receipt as filing evidence only until protection lane and court/service state are joined.
tests.label: Asylum/protection filing and court routing
tests.question: Does the packet separate I-589 completion, USCIS or EOIR lane, NTA/court routing, acceptance/rejection, DHS service, evidence, interpreter, interview/hearing, and appeal/remedy?

tests.fail_or_repair: Do not treat asylum-clock time or I-765 filing as work authorization until card/extension and acceptance evidence exist.
tests.label: Work authorization, EAD clock, and card continuity
tests.question: Are I-765 category, asylum EAD clock, applicant-caused delays, approval, card production/delivery, renewal, replacement, and employer/agency recognition proven?

tests.fail_or_repair: Do not treat docket lookup or portal visibility as due process without filing, notice, hearing, language, and remedy evidence.
tests.label: EOIR court file, hearing, and electronic filing
tests.question: Are ACIS, Respondent Access, ECAS/eROP, hearing date, filings, acceptance/rejection emails, evidence, interpreter, counsel, appeals, and outage/deadline rules separated?

tests.fail_or_repair: Treat SAVE as a verification lane only until the benefit/license/work/school decision and correction are proven.
tests.label: SAVE and downstream agency verification
tests.question: Does the packet connect SAVE request, requesting agency, initial/additional verification, CaseCheck, mismatch, agency decision, and correction/restoration route?

tests.fail_or_repair: Add assisted access and deadline protection before relying on online-only case or filing surfaces.
tests.label: Digital, paper, language, and assisted-access fallback
tests.question: Are portal account, device/broadband, mobile/desktop limits, paper filing, language/disability access, trusted helper, and account recovery available before deadlines run?

tests.fail_or_repair: Activate custody/reentry and watchlist/border tests before treating enforcement rows as status resolution.
tests.label: Custody, enforcement, release, and status consequence
tests.question: If detention, transfer, check-in, bond, release, removal, or custody transport is involved, are notice, counsel, medical, family, court, and status consequences preserved?

tests.fail_or_repair: Downgrade complaint/inquiry status to unresolved until corrected records and restored consequences are documented.
tests.label: Remedy, correction, and source currentness
tests.question: Does the packet prove service request, inquiry, motion, appeal, record correction, card reissue, SAVE correction, restored downstream service, and source-currentness posture?

use_rule: Run immigration-status tests whenever USCIS receipts, case-status pages, processing times, I-589 asylum filings, I-765 work-authorization applications, asylum EAD-clock evidence, USCIS/EOIR address changes, immigration-court dockets, Respondent Access/ECAS/eROP records, SAVE responses, CaseCheck, detention/release, or downstream benefit/license/work/school decisions are cited as proof that a person has status, work authorization, notice, hearing safety, access, or remedy. Separate person, case, notice, filing, asylum/protection, work, court, SAVE/downstream, digital access, custody, representative, and repair states before treating a receipt, docket, clock, address form, portal, or verification response as status.
